briefdescription.para: isZExtFree - Return true if any actual instruction that defines a value of type Ty1 implicit zero-extends the value to Ty2 in the result register.

detaileddescription.para: This does not necessarily include registers defined in unknown ways, such as incoming arguments, or copies from unknown virtual registers. Also, if isTruncateFree(Ty2, Ty1) is true, this does not necessarily apply to truncate instructions. e.g. on msp430, all instructions that define 8-bit values implicit zero-extend the result out to 16 bits.

detaileddescription.para: These instructions are special in various ways, which require special support to insert.
